arabic text: SUNAI KIS NE YEH ZINDAN MEIN LORI SAKINA SO RAHI HAI.
english translation text: WHO IN THE PRISON TOLD THIS LULLABY, 'SAKINA IS SLEEPING'

arabic text: KHUDARA, ZOOR SE BOLE NA KOI, SAKINA SO RAHI HAI.
english translation text: BY ALLAH, KEEP QUIET, SAKINA IS SLEEPING

arabic text: KAHA BANO NE UTHO SHAH ZADI\nHUWI KYA BAAT JO MADAR SE ROTHI.
english translation text: BANO SAID, 'WAKE UP, MY PRINCESS,\nWHAT HAPPENED, WHY WON’T YOU TALK TO ME?'

arabic text: UTHO BABA KA SAR AAYA HAI BIBI, MAGAR ZINDAAN KI HAR DEWAR BOLI. SAKINA SO RAHI HAI.
english translation text: WAKE UP, FATHER’S HEAD HAS COME OH BIBI! BUT THE PRISON’S WALLS SAID, 'SAKINA IS SLEEPING.'

arabic text: TUMHARE GOSHWAREY MIL GAYE HAIN DAR-E-ZINDAN SARE KHUL GAYE HAIN.
english translation text: YOUR EARRINGS HAVE BEEN RETURNED, ALL THE DOORS OF PRISON ARE NOW OPEN

arabic text: REHAI MIL GAYI JATI HOON GHAR KO MAGAR SAJJAD KI AAWAZ AAYI. SAKINA SO RAHI HAI.
english translation text: BUT SAJJAD SAYS, 'SAKINA IS SLEEPING.' WE WERE FREED, HEADING TOWARDS HOME,

arabic text: HOYE JAB SHAM KE SAYE BHI GEHRAY PARINDAY CHEHCHAHATE JA RAHE THEY.
english translation text: WHEN SHADOWS GREW LONGER, THE BIRDS WERE SINGING,

arabic text: KAHA BANO NE AYE URTAY PARINDO SADAEIN ROOK LO KUCH DAIR APNI. SAKINA SO RAHI HAI.
english translation text: BANO SAID, 'OH BIRDS, STOP SINGING FOR A BIT, SAKINA IS SLEEPING'

arabic text: BANANE QABAR JAB SAJJAD UTHAY TU WOH NAD-E-ALI DOHRA RAHE THE.
english translation text: HE RECITED NAD-E-ALI REPEATEDLY WHEN SAJJAD STOOD UP TO MAKE THE GRAVE,

arabic text: BANDHE HATHON SE CHAHA QABAR KHODEIN ACHANAK PAON KI ZANJEER CHANKI. SAKINA SO RAHI HAI.
english translation text: HE WISHED TO DIG THE GRAVE WITH HIS TIED HANDS, SUDDENLY, THE CHAINS ON HIS FEET CLANKED, 'SAKINA IS SLEEPING.'

arabic text: NA AB MARAY GA KOI TAMACHE NA HOON GAYE PHIR SE YEH RUKHSAR NEELAY.
english translation text: NEITHER WILL ANYONE SLAP YOU, NOR WILL YOUR CHEEK TURN BLUE

arabic text: GALA BANDHA NA JAYE GA RASAN MEIN JO AAYA SHIMAR TU OSS SE KAHON GI. SAKINA SO RAHI HAI.
english translation text: NECK WONT BE TIED IN CHAINS, IF SHIMR COMES, I WILL SAY TO HIM, 'SAKINA IS SLEEPING'

arabic text: ADAB KI JA HAI YEH:REHAN: DEKHO BULAND AAWAZ MEIN HARGIZ NA BOLO.
english translation text: THIS IS A PLACE OF RESPECT, REHAN, SEE! NEVER TALK OUT LOUD HERE

arabic text: YAHAN TU FATIHA BHI DHERAY PARHNA YAHAN AAWAZ HO JAYE NA ONCHI. SAKINA SO RAHI HAI.
english translation text: HERE, EVEN RECITE FATIHA LIGHTLY, … HERE, NO ONE SHOULD RAISE THEIR SOUND, 'SAKINA IS SLEEPING'
